value.rationale: Antipodal links are a canonical physically natural augmentation of the cube, and the quantity is the exact first absorption chance and unconditional duration at a designated absorbing vertex. Unit link tuning forces a surprising \(d/(d+1)\) loss of eventual capture, while arbitrarily slight detuning restores capture but with a sharp quadratic mean-time cost. An all-resonance classification and large-d amplitude give structural control beyond a small finite table. The result is specific to coherent ideal dynamics, with no claim of experimental robustness.
